name: attempt
notes: HARDWARE GESTURE, new for the 'told how, now try it' beat (Agent F's flow). Offsets from the resting pose. LOOKS LIKE: the arm commits to a try — it leans in and reaches down with joint4 pitched well over, closes the jaws, lifts a little as if testing whether it has the thing, then lets go and withdraws. The small lift is the point: it is the part that looks like checking, which is what makes the motion read as an attempt rather than a rehearsed success. It is honest about what it is — nothing was taught from a demonstration and there is no perception in the loop, so the arm is trying a shape of motion, not verifying a grasp. Peak 8.5 deg/s (ceiling 15), gripper 11.0 %/s (limit 12).

waypoints.label: test lift — did I get it?
